text:
Hamburg’s median asking rent stands at 15.47 €/m², up 5.1 % year‑on‑year and 28.5 % over the past five years, placing the city fifth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 69 %, while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 928 € per month.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1 % and properties staying on the market for an average of 23 days; 37 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 18.8 %, reflecting limited affordability despite modest population growth of 3.6 % over five years.

The model‑based forecast for the next 12 months predicts a median asking rent of 16.28 €/m², ranging between 15.91 €/m² and 16.67 €/m², implying a further 5.2 % increase.
